property_summary: After any caller (owner) calls NETM(), the owner's balance equals the contract's totalDistributed in the reference; the mutant sets it to totalSupply, so there exist inputs where balances(owner) != totalDistributed (i.e., mutant differs).
change_summary: Replace the body of NETM() to initialize the owner's balance to totalSupply instead of totalDistributed, changing balances after calling NETM.
